# Parallel Execution with Background Jobs and Limits

Throttling background jobs to a maximum concurrency pool:

```bash
MAX_JOBS=4
for url in "${urls[@]}"; do
    curl -sO "$url" &
    # If pool is full, wait for any one job to complete
    if [[ $(jobs -r -p | wc -l) -ge $MAX_JOBS ]]; then
        wait -n
    fi
done
wait
```
